cohort: 40 patients at term with breech presentation who underwent ECV with epidural analgesia and labor induction or cesarean section
finding: Induction of labor after successful ECV with epidural analgesia at term can be considered in selected patients to avoid cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study investigated the benefits of external cephalic version (ECV) with epidural analgesia at term, followed by immediate labor induction, finding that this approach led to a high rate of vaginal deliveries (50%) and could potentially reduce the number of cesarean deliveries.
